macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks suffer worst session since July as inflation accelerates
items.summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.1%, the Nasdaq Composite dropped 1.9%, and the Dow slipped 0.1% after September inflation rose 3.7% year over year, above expectations. Rising Treasury yields pressured technology stocks, with Nvidia, Broadcom, and AMD among the largest decliners.

items.title: Hot inflation increases expectations for another Fed rate hike
items.summary: Traders raised the implied probability of a Federal Reserve rate increase at the next meeting to nearly 35%, from 22% a day earlier. New York Fed President John Williams said another increase this year may be appropriate, while the Fed was also scheduled to release its Beige Book.

items.title: Bank earnings fail to reassure investors
items.summary: Bank of America fell 4.8% after reporting weaker-than-expected quarterly profit and revenue, while State Street declined 4.1% despite beating profit forecasts. JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs posted higher overall profits but reported pressure in fixed-income trading.

items.title: ASML raises annual outlook on AI-chip equipment demand
items.summary: ASML lifted its annual forecast for the third time this year, citing efforts to expand production of semiconductor equipment amid strong demand tied to artificial-intelligence infrastructure.

items.title: China exports surge, adding to trade-tension concerns
items.summary: Chinese exports rose 36.3% from a year earlier in September, exceeding expectations and potentially intensifying trade tensions with major partners. China's producer-price inflation also accelerated to 5.0% year over year.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies fall after hotter U.S. inflation report
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped roughly 1.5%–1.8% to about $82,000–$82,800 after U.S. inflation exceeded expectations, while Ethereum, Solana and XRP also declined. The broader crypto market capitalization fell as traders reassessed Federal Reserve rate-hike prospects.

items.title: SEC enables new crypto-linked options framework
items.summary: The SEC made operative a Cboe BZX rule change establishing a framework for options on commodity-based trusts holding multiple crypto assets. The agency also approved binary options tied to metrics including Coinbase trading volume and MARA Bitcoin production.

items.title: EBA classifies USDC as the EU’s first significant e-money token
items.summary: The European Banking Authority classified USDC as a significant e-money token under the Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation. Starting November 12, 2026, the EBA and France’s banking supervisor are expected to share oversight responsibilities.

items.title: Brazil securities regulator launches distributed-ledger pilot
items.summary: Brazil’s securities commission launched a DLT pilot covering securities issuance, trading and post-trade processes. The program will assess interoperability, practical viability and regulatory risks.

items.title: Solana schedules Alpenglow mainnet upgrade
items.summary: Solana reportedly scheduled its Alpenglow upgrade for October 21. The upgrade aims to reduce payment-confirmation times to approximately 150 milliseconds.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Argon frontier model
items.summary: Google reportedly launched Gemini 4 Argon for selected Gemini app and cloud customers, targeting coding, cybersecurity, science, finance and law. Introductory API pricing is reported at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.[2]

items.title: Anthropic warns of self-replicating AI malware
items.summary: Anthropic research warns that increasingly capable small models could eventually enable self-replicating malware targeting internet-of-things devices, including smart home appliances.[2]

items.title: Nvidia pledges $250 million for UK AI safety research
items.summary: Nvidia announced a five-year compute donation valued at $250 million to strengthen the United Kingdom’s research into agentic AI safety and security.[1]

items.title: Google and DeepMind expand model access for European researchers
items.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud said they will provide up to 200 European scientific researchers with direct access to models including AlphaFold 3, WeatherNext, AlphaGenome, AlphaEvolve and AlphaEarth Foundations, alongside $3 million in compute credits.[1]

items.title: Scimplify raises $25 million for AI-driven specialty chemicals
items.summary: Indian startup Scimplify raised $25 million in an all-equity round led by Hitachi Ventures, bringing its reported total equity funding to $80 million. The company uses AI to manage specialty-chemical sourcing and production.[2]

items.title: AI companies pursue recursive self-improvement
items.summary: Technology companies are increasingly developing systems intended to design or train improved successors, a strategy known as recursive self-improvement.[4]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Microsoft launches Xbox Labs for browser and new-device gaming
items.summary: Microsoft introduced Xbox Labs, a team focused on adapting games—including older titles—for browsers and devices beyond their original platforms. The company has not announced specific games, release dates, or pricing.

items.title: Epic Games reportedly delays Marvel and Star Wars shooter amid AI push
items.summary: Epic Games has reportedly postponed its unannounced Marvel and Star Wars crossover shooter as the company shifts development resources toward artificial-intelligence tools. The new release window remains unclear.

items.title: Epic reveals redesigned game launcher built with ‘vibe coding’
items.summary: Epic Games announced a redesigned Epic Games Launcher, describing its development as an example of “vibe coding.” The announcement follows reports that the company is making a significant strategic shift toward AI.

items.title: WWE files trademark for potential game titled WWE: Survive The Ride
items.summary: WWE filed a trademark covering mobile and computer games under the name “WWE: Survive The Ride.” The filing does not confirm a specific game, developer, platform, or release date.

items.title: Bloomberg details the development and delays of Grand Theft Auto VI
items.summary: A Bloomberg feature examines the production of Grand Theft Auto VI, including its previous delays and expected November 19 release. The game is projected to become one of the largest entertainment launches in history.
